adds.title: X2
adds.text: Logan returns to Xavier's school wanting more about his past. Xavier tells him he must find some answers for himself and leaves him to watch the students.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Tells Logan to find some answers himself.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Back at Xavier's school, left to watch the students.
adds.evidence: Fandom plot: Wolverine returns, Xavier shows him Cerebro, says he can't tell him everything and he must find out some things himself; Wolverine is left to babysit the children.

adds.title: X2
adds.text: Storm calls Logan in Boston and flies the X-Jet in to pick him and the students up after the police standoff.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Picks Logan up in the X-Jet in Boston.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Picked up by Storm in Boston.
adds.evidence: Fandom plot: Wolverine receives a call from Storm, who decides to come pick them up; the X-Jet arrives after the police standoff. Wikipedia: Storm, Jean and Nightcrawler pick them up in their jet.

adds.title: X2
adds.text: Logan gets Rogue out of the school during Stryker's raid and keeps her with him on the run to Boston.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Flees the raid on the school with Logan.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Gets Rogue out of the school during the raid.
adds.evidence: Fandom plot: Wolverine, Rogue, Bobby and Pyro escape the raid in Cyclops' car and head to Boston together.

adds.title: X2
adds.text: During Stryker's raid on the school, Colossus and Logan round up students and get them to safety.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Helps Logan get students out during the raid.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Rounds up students with Colossus during the raid.
adds.evidence: Fandom plot: 'Colossus and Wolverine round up a number of the students' during the military raid. Wikipedia: Colossus leads the remaining students to safety.

adds.title: X2
adds.text: Charles visits Erik in his plastic prison, where Erik admits he told Stryker everything about Cerebro. Later Erik turns Stryker's Cerebro so the captive Charles will kill every human.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Gives Charles's secrets to Stryker, then turns him on humanity.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Used by Magneto to try to kill every human.
adds.evidence: Fandom plot: Magneto confesses to Xavier that he told Stryker everything; at Alkali Lake Magneto reconfigures Dark Cerebro and Mystique has Jason make Xavier target humans.

adds.title: X2
adds.text: Xavier takes Scott with him to question Magneto, and Stryker's people capture them both at the prison.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Goes with Xavier to see Magneto and is captured with him.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Taken captive with Scott at Magneto's prison.
adds.evidence: Fandom plot: Cyclops and Professor X visit Magneto in the plastic prison; gas knocks out Xavier and Deathstrike defeats Cyclops; both are captured.

adds.title: X2
adds.text: As Jean holds back the flood at Alkali Lake, she speaks her goodbye to the team through Xavier's mind.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Says goodbye to the team through Xavier's mind.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: The mentor Jean speaks through as she says goodbye.
adds.evidence: Wikipedia plot: 'Jean telepathically says goodbye through Xavier as flames erupt from her body' before the flood crashes down on her.

adds.title: X2
adds.text: Storm has Nightcrawler take her into Stryker's Cerebro, where she freezes the room to break Jason's hold and free Xavier.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Freezes Stryker's Cerebro to free Xavier.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Freed by Storm from Stryker's Cerebro.
adds.evidence: Fandom plot: Storm persuades Nightcrawler to get inside Cerebro and intensifies the cold, freezing Jason to save Professor X. Wikipedia: Nightcrawler teleports Storm inside Cerebro where she creates a snowstorm to free Xavier.

adds.title: X2
adds.text: Rogue goes with Xavier's X-Men to the White House and hands the President Stryker's files while Xavier warns him.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Hands the President Stryker's files beside Xavier.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Leads Rogue and the X-Men to the White House.
adds.evidence: Fandom plot: at the White House 'Rogue gives him the files from Stryker's private offices while Professor X tells him about the events'. Wikipedia lists Rogue among the X-Men there.

adds.title: X2
adds.text: Mystique poisons a guard with iron so Magneto can break out of his plastic prison. Together they turn Stryker's Cerebro on humans and escape in his helicopter.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Frees Magneto from his plastic prison.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: The leader Mystique breaks out of prison.
adds.evidence: Fandom plot: Mystique injects guard Laurio with iron, which Magneto pulls out to escape; at Alkali Lake Magneto reconfigures Cerebro and Mystique, as Stryker, has Jason target humans; they take Stryker's helicopter.

adds.title: X2
adds.text: On the flight to Alkali Lake, Magneto taunts Rogue about the white streak in her hair, a reminder of how he nearly killed her.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Taunted by Magneto over the streak in her hair.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Taunts Rogue about the night he nearly killed her.
adds.evidence: Fandom plot: 'Magneto taunts Rogue about the white streaks in her hair, reminding her of their first encounter when he'd almost killed her.'

adds.title: X2
adds.text: Jean reads Nightcrawler's mind to find Stryker's base for Magneto's plan, then goes in with him to keep an eye on him and holds off a brainwashed Cyclops so he can reach Cerebro.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Joins Magneto's raid to keep an eye on him.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Works with Jean to stop Stryker.
adds.evidence: Fandom plot: Magneto needs Jean to read Nightcrawler's mind for the base location; 'Jean Grey joins Magneto and Mystique in order to keep an eye on them' and fights Cyclops 'to buy Magneto enough time to get to Dark Cerebro'.
